## Où j'en suis
Session on `daniel/hubspot-owner-sync`: the webhook approach for HubSpot owner/ARR sync was abandoned (private app tokens can't manage webhook subscriptions via API), so webhooks were replaced with a 15-min polling job via CRM search, with windowed paging past the 10k result cap and a filter syncing only companies with ARR > 0. PR #405 was closed and PR #409 opened with auto-merge, but the e2e test `test_admin_accounts.py::test_accounts_table_shows_owner` fails (expects 3 owner rows, gets 2, because the trial fixture company is now skipped), so #409 is still open and not merged.

- [en-cours] Fix e2e fixture in `tests/e2e/test_admin_accounts.py` (give third company ARR > 0, or expect 2 rows) so #409's required check passes
- [prochaine-étape] Once e2e passes, auto-merge will squash-merge PR #409
- [prochaine-étape] Noa to add `HUBSPOT_TOKEN` to AWS Secrets Manager for staging/prod
- [essai-raté] Webhook subscription registration via API (curl) failed: 401, private app tokens unsupported; PR #405 closed as superseded
- [essai-raté] Initial backfill test hit the 10k CRM search cap; fixed by windowed paging (commits 8b3e6f1, 2d90ac4, ae47c15)
- [décision] Poll every 15 min instead of webhooks (source: t04)
- [décision] Sync only companies with ARR > 0, skip trials entirely (source: t10)
- [décision] Store token in Secrets Manager for staging/prod, handled by Noa (source: t12)
